title: Shopping
description: Learn how to ask for prices, shop at stores and markets, and pay for items.
guidebook:
Shopping in Portuguese is fun and easy! To ask the price of an item, use the essential question **Quanto custa?** (*How much does it cost?*) or simply **Quanto é?** (*How much is it?*).

When describing items, remember that adjectives agree with the gender of the noun. A coat (*o casaco*) is **caro** (*expensive*) or **barato** (*cheap*), whereas a shirt (*a camisa*) is **cara** or **barata**.

When it is time to check out, you can say **Vou pagar em dinheiro** (*I will pay in cash*) or ask **Aceita cartão?** (*Do you accept card?*). Finally, wrap up smoothly with **A conta, por favor!** (*The bill, please!*).

phrases.native: How much does this shirt cost?
I want to buy a book.
We are going to the market today.
Is there any discount in this store?
She wants to pay in cash.
Can I pay the bill now?
